rules.title: Cambridge Fair Housing Ordinance: housing discrimination ban, including source of income
rules.requirement: Landlords and rental agents may not discriminate in renting or in the terms of tenancy based on protected categories. These categories include source of income (such as Section 8 and public benefits), race, disability, family status and others. Applicants may be screened only by reasonable standards, such as ability to pay rent and care for the apartment, applied equally to all.
rules.coverage_conditions: Rental housing and other real estate transactions in Cambridge; applies to landlords, sellers and rental agents.
rules.exemptions: Two-family dwellings where the owner lives in one unit.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Exemption for owner-occupied two-family dwellings depends on owner occupancy.

rules.penalty: The Commission can file a criminal complaint and levy civil fines of up to $300 per violation. It can also seek injunctive relief in Superior Court, damages and expenses.
rules.citation: Cambridge Municipal Code ch. 14.04 (Cambridge Fair Housing Ordinance)
